messages:
maria: Heads-up — spotted a regression in the Python quickstart README when I tried the sample app this morning. The snippet uses `RedwoodClient(api_key=...)` which is not a valid ctor in v1 SDK anymore.

maria: Error I saw when running the example: `TypeError: RedWoodClient.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'api_key'` :facepalm:

tom: oh damn, thanks for catching. That sample was last updated in the old branch. Is it just the ctor or other calls too? :eyes:

maria: Mostly ctor and a generate call. Old snippet:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(prompt='hello')
print(resp.text)
```

maria: New v1 SDK wants:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(auth=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_TOKEN'])
resp = client.text.generate(input='hello')
print(resp.output_text)
```

kevin: Also the quickstart mentions `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var in two places. We standardize on `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` now — that'll confuse users.

tom: Good catch. We should: update the ctor example, update `REDWOOD_API_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` across README, and add a tiny migration note for folks on older SDKs.

maria: I can open a small docs PR. Plan: 1) fix snippet, 2) add a one-line note about SDK v1 naming, 3) add a CI doc build smoke test that imports Client.

docs-bot: new issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/412 - "quickstart python snippet broken after SDK v1"

tom: If you want, follow the pattern we used in other READMEs: minimal example + link to full sample app. Keep snippet to 5 lines max.

maria: Will do. Thinking of replacing the snippet with this compact version:```python
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(auth=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_TOKEN'))
print(client.text.generate(input='hello').output_text)
```

kevin: Also add a short note about retries/auth retries — people copy the snippet into serverless and forget to set a retry policy. Maybe one-liner: "For production, set a retry policy — see SDK docs."

maria: Good call. I'll add a second tiny snippet showing a basic retry wrapper, something like:```python
from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt
@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3))
def generate(p):
    return client.text.generate(input=p)
```

tom: Nice. After PR, please add a test to the docs CI that does `python -c "from redwood import Client; Client(auth='x')"` to catch ctor name regressions.

maria: Added that to the PR description. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/913 - includes snippet update + env var rename + CI smoke.

ci-bot: docs build started for PR 913 (job #5789).

ci-bot: docs build failed: autodoc import error in quickstart (ImportError: cannot import name 'RedwoodClient') — this is expected until PR merges.

tom: Looks good. Once CI smoke test uses `Client` name it'll fail on older branches and prevent regressions.

kevin: One more nit — check other language samples (node, go) to ensure env var naming parity and mention in CHANGELOG.

maria: Yep I'll scan them and open follow-up issues if mismatches. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: Thanks — appreciate the quick fix.

maria: merging once green and will backport the README change to the 0.x-stable docs branch with a note.

ci-bot: docs build passed for PR 913 (job #5795)"
